description: Show how a brand's buybox concentration has changed over time. Returns weekly seller counts and observed buybox days for the trailing window. Use when the user asks 'is this brand getting more competitive', 'concentration trend for Nike', 'how has seller count changed over time', or 'buybox trajectory'.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_seller_count.description: Keep only timeline weeks with at least this seller_count.

since_weeks.description: Weeks of history to return (default 26, max 52).

trend_in.description: Comma-separated trend labels to keep: CONCENTRATING, DECONCENTRATING, STABLE, INSUFFICIENT_DATA. If the brand's trend isn't in the list, an empty result is returned.

week_start_from.description: Keep only timeline weeks on/after this YYYY-MM-DD.

name: brand_buybox_trajectory
